acceptedAnswer.text: Navigating local zoning and building codes is a crucial step. Zen Tiny Homes assists clients in understanding and complying with regulations specific to their intended location, such as Vista or Oceanside. We recommend researching local ordinances early in the process, as rules vary regarding minimum dwelling size, foundation requirements, and utility hookups. For tiny homes on wheels, specific RV or park model certifications may apply. We help ensure your design and construction plan align with these requirements for a smooth permitting process.
